title: OpenAI Fellows Fall 2018
snippet: We’re now accepting applications for the next cohort of OpenAI Fellows, a program which offers a compensated 6-month apprenticeship in AI research at OpenAI.

title: AI and compute
snippet: We’re releasing an analysis showing that since 2012, the amount of compute used in the largest AI training runs has been increasing exponentially with a 3.4-month doubling time (by comparison, Moore’s Law had a 2-year doubling period)[^foot

title: AI safety via debate
snippet: We’re proposing an AI safety technique which trains agents to debate topics with one another, using a human to judge who wins.
